description: Play the scenario quickly without filming. Reports each step; for a missing element, lists the visible targets you can use instead, with a screenshot of where it stopped. It really performs the steps in the app (a click on Send sends, a click on Delete deletes): use a demo account or a staging environment.

path.description: Path of the scenario JSON file. Prefer an absolute path; a relative one is resolved from the server's working directory.

scenario.description: Optional scenario object: validated, then written to `path` (overwriting that file), then used.

name: screenplay_check
title: Check a scenario
